# quay_organization_prototype (Resource)

Manages a Quay default permission prototype. A prototype automatically grants a role to a user, robot or team on every new repository created by the activating user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quay_organization" "main" {
  name  = "main"
  email = "quay+main@example.com"
}

resource "quay_organization_robot" "push" {
  name    = "push"
  orgname = quay_organization.main.name
}

resource "quay_organization_robot" "pull" {
  name    = "pull"
  orgname = quay_organization.main.name
}

# Grant the pull robot read access to every new repository created by the push robot.
resource "quay_organization_prototype" "test" {
  orgname         = quay_organization.main.name
  activating_user = quay_organization_robot.push.fullname
  delegate_name   = quay_organization_robot.pull.fullname
  delegate_kind   = "user"
  role            = "read"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activating_user` (String) Name of the user or robot (full name for robots, e.g. `org+robot`) whose repository creation triggers the rule
- `delegate_kind` (String) Whether the delegate is a user or a team. Should be `user` or `team`.
- `delegate_name` (String) Name of the user, robot (full name, e.g. `org+robot`) or team that receives the permission
- `orgname` (String) Organization name
- `role` (String) Permission role. Should be `read`, `write` or `admin`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Prototype ID assigned by Quay

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An organization prototype can be imported using the organization name and the prototype ID.
terraform import quay_organization_prototype.test main/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
